Description
This is Volume 53 of the popular martial-arts comedy manga 功夫旋風兒 (Kung Fu Boy) by Tatsuya Egawa (蛭田達也).
Published by Tong Li Comics (東立出版社) in Taiwan, this official Traditional Chinese edition is part of Tong Li’s classic licensed run from the 1990s.
The volume features the series’ signature mix of martial arts action and light-hearted humor. It also includes an author photo and commentary section inside.
